queries:
WITH status_rates AS (
    SELECT
        q.valistate AS status,
        AVG(s.pressratio) AS rate,
        COUNT(*) AS valid_scan_count
    FROM scanqc AS q
    JOIN scans AS s
      ON s.arcref = q.arcref
     AND s.crewref = q.crewref
    WHERE s.pressratio IS NOT NULL
      AND s.pressratio > 0
    GROUP BY q.valistate
)
SELECT
    status,
    rate,
    SUM(rate * valid_scan_count) OVER () * 1.0
        / SUM(valid_scan_count) OVER () AS overall_rate
FROM status_rates

WITH valid_scans AS (
  SELECT sites.presstat AS status,
         scans.gbsize,
         scans.spanmin
  FROM scans
  JOIN sites ON sites.zoneregistry = scans.zoneref
  WHERE scans.gbsize > 0
    AND scans.spanmin > 0
)
SELECT status,
       AVG(gbsize / spanmin) AS status_rate,
       (SELECT SUM(gbsize) / SUM(spanmin) FROM valid_scans) AS overall_rate
FROM valid_scans
GROUP BY status;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT zoneref)
FROM scans
WHERE gbsize IS NOT NULL
  AND spanmin IS NOT NULL
  AND spanmin <> 0
